description:
About the company
 
 Our client is an AI-first permanent-capital software group that acquires mission-critical vertical SaaS companies and operates them for the long term. The company has raised more than $50M, acquired eight businesses in under two years, and is building a shared applied-AI platform across its portfolio. Distribution, executive sponsorship, customer relationships, and deployment budgets are already in place.
 
 The role and why it matters
 
 This is a founding Forward Deployed Engineer role with direct access to the co-founders and Head of AI. You will build and deploy applied-AI products across multiple vertical software companies, identify repeatable patterns, and turn successful deployments into reusable platform capabilities.
 
 What you'll do
 
 • Run discovery with executives and operators, translate business problems into product specifications, and build AI workflows from scratch.
 • Own full deployment lifecycles from zero-to-one implementation through customer adoption.
 • Work on-site with customer decision-makers and technical teams across portfolio companies.
 • Build shared data models, ontologies, and workflow infrastructure that connect deployments into reusable vertical products.
 • Partner directly with the co-founders, Head of AI, and portfolio CTO to define and execute the applied-AI strategy.
 • Help establish the Forward Deployed Engineering pod, operating model, and technical standards.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 
 • 3 to 5 years of hands-on software engineering or forward-deployed engineering experience.
 • A track record leading technical deployments from discovery through production and adoption.
 • Strong full-stack engineering, systems architecture, and data-pipeline fundamentals.
 • Experience building with LLMs, applied machine learning, or AI workflow systems.
 • Ability to work directly with C-level customers and translate ambiguous operational needs into shipped products.
 • Founder-minded ownership, autonomy, and comfort operating without extensive structure.
 • Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites.
 
 Bonus points
 
 • Experience productizing patterns across multiple deployments or customers.
 • Experience with vertical SaaS, enterprise software, or portfolio-company environments.
 • Familiarity with ontology-driven platforms or centralized enterprise data models.
 • Experience helping build an engineering team or new technical function.
 
 Location and work model
 
 • Full-time role based in New York City or Chicago.
 • Five days per week in the office, with frequent customer travel.
 • Candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
 Benefits 
 • $200,000 to $300,000 base salary.
 • Competitive equity.
 • Founding-level ownership of a new applied-AI business.
 • Direct access to company founders, portfolio executives, and customer decision-makers.
